notes:
Scope: VCG is the sole urban bus operator (route_type 3) in Ponta Grossa, PR. No metro/rail/BRT exists in the city, so all 94 routes are buses. Route list (line numbers + names) extracted verbatim from horariodeonibus.net/horario-de-onibus-vcg/ (91 lines) plus 3 more from the same site's terminal-connector index (216/218/219) = 94 routes total.

STOPS (87): Only the 4 city integration terminals + Parque dos Pinheiros terminus have evidence-grounded WGS-84 coordinates. Terminal Central (Rua Benjamin Constant, Centro), Terminal Oficinas (Av. Visconde de Mauá; IBGE -25.1278,-50.1551), Terminal Uvaranas (Av. Gen. Carlos Cavalcanti, OSM node N4287261789), Terminal Nova Rússia (R. Pref. Campos Melo, Boa Vista; CEP -25.062,-50.167) — all confirmed via WebSearch of CEP/IBGE/OSM/Waze. The other 82 stops are per-line neighbourhood termini named from the route name, with APPROXIMATE bairro-centroid coordinates (derived from CEP-range references, ~0.5-1 km accuracy, NOT surveyed points). These are labelled approximations, not invented street stops.

NETWORK MODEL: VCG is a radial hub-and-spoke network centred on Terminal Central (Moovit confirms nearly every line serves it). Each radial line is modelled as a 2-stop trip Terminal Central <-> destination bairro. Terminal-pair lines (052/053/058/069/073/084/095/134/216/218/219, plus 047 Interbairros, 049 Boa Vista, 075) are anchored on their two named terminals. Intermediate stops are NOT modelled because per-stop coordinates were unavailable: Moovit's ~2,649-stop itineraries render via JavaScript and could not be fetched, and OpenStreetMap/Overpass was unreachable from the sandbox (network egress blocked, curl exit 7). vcg.com.br 302-redirects HTTPS->HTTP which WebFetch cannot follow; onibusja/tonoponto returned 403; the city gov portal timed out / refused connection.

SCHEDULE: Line 075 Parque dos Pinheiros uses REAL published clock times (24 outbound 06:20-23:40, 24 inbound 06:00-23:20) extracted from horariodeonibus.net line-75 page, which also established daily service (weekday=Sat=Sun/holiday). All other lines use an even 20-min headway across the observed service span 06:00-23:40, both directions — realistic frequency but not the actual published timetable. Full generated feed (94 routes, 10,092 trips, 20,184 stop_times) written to /home/ubuntu/adresses/gtfs_vcg/ (agency.txt, stops.txt, routes.txt, trips.txt, stop_times.txt, calendar.txt); build script build.py. The arrays returned here are a valid representative subset: all 94 routes, one trip per direction (188 trips, 376 stop_times) — every route has both directions, every trip has >=2 ordered monotonic stop_times, all stop refs resolve, all coords within the Ponta Grossa bbox.

Confidence 0.42: route inventory and terminal geometry are solid and real; the per-line stop chains and (aside from line 075) the timetables are structurally plausible reconstructions rather than the operator's true stop-by-stop schedule.
